### 💊 Clinical Overview: **Paracetamol**

• **Generic Name:** Acetaminophen
• **Drug Class:** Analgesic / Antipyretic
• **Category:** `OTC`
• **Typical Dosage:** 500-1000 mg every 4-6 hours (max 4g/day)

**Common Side Effects:**
• nausea
• liver damage (overdose)
• rash

**Contraindications & Warnings:**
• ⚠️ severe liver disease
• ⚠️ alcohol dependence

*Always consult a licensed medical doctor before administering any medication.*
